name: Urchin
description: A spiky fuzz and distortion box with real character. Six Spines, each its own circuit: Gated Fuzz (a starved, sputtering fuzz with Bias as Starve), Octave Fuzz (rectified: high notes ring an octave up), Torn Speaker (a cone that bottoms out and buzzes), Rectifier (half- and full-wave folding grit), Wavefolder (West Coast folds) and Overdrive. Drive, a Tone tilt with Mids/Lows pre-emphasis, Bias, Bloom (sag that compresses and spits), a Gate that can chop, Blend and Low Keep to keep the low end clean, and Spike: one Q-Link from mild to ruined. 2x oversampled with anti-aliased shapers and an automatic level match; Stereo, a cheaper Mono core, or Split: a different Spine on each side, like two amps panned apart, with Width.
author: Groundswell
